conformance_surfaces.role: The sole resource NSC-071 owns and the Play Mode fixture VAL-001 describes: it loads the committed Bone Archive scene asset and proves each lane traverses within its own envelope.

gate_results.notes: Satisfied at validated commit 09e1d9d3ac23029e52a42ff1754ba355b5e8a736 by the bound Play Mode run in unity_01_results and unity_01_log: 9 of 9 passed, 0 failed, repository clean before and after. Each test was verified present and Passed BY NAME in the results XML rather than inferred from the total. The gate's central demand is that a complete path between two points does not prove the lane between them, and the fixture answers it directly: AToBLane_TraversesItsOwnEnvelopeFromSouthAisleToNorthAisle and BToCLane_TraversesBa1PinchWithinItsOwnEnvelope assert each lane INDEPENDENTLY, WesternBypass_TraversesW1NarrowingWithinItsOwnEnvelope and EasternBypass_TraversesE1NarrowingWithinItsOwnEnvelope cover the two bypasses, North and South CrossAisle tests connect the lane mouths, BakeReadsOnlyTheCommittedGameplayGeometry holds it to the committed scene asset rather than a builder-produced or synthetic one, ConfiguredAgent_MatchesTheBakedSurfaceSettings_AndItsRadiusIsRecorded ties it to the NSC-089 agent configuration, and D1ToD2Route_IsComplete_ButIsDeliberatelyNotEvidenceAboutAnyLane is explicit that the end-to-end route is NOT lane evidence. THE W-1 AND E-1 BYPASSES COULD NOT BE TRAVERSED BEFORE 2026-09-25: those archive bays did not exist in any file under Assets until NSC-045's widened blockout landed earlier tonight. NOT PROVEN: this is the Bone Archive only and says nothing about the composed five-room floor, which NSC-110 owns. No Edit Mode run was made and no human review is claimed or implied.

human_approval.notes: No human approval is claimed. NSC-071 has exactly one completion gate and it is an automated Play Mode gate with no human review clause. Hand authored rather than via generate_delivery_spec finalize because that tool's non-required path demands a pipeline validation event id and this Unity run was performed by hand with Pipeline/Testing/run_unity_tests_clean.ps1; citing an event the pipeline never issued would overstate the evidence. Same shape as the NSC-050, NSC-020, NSC-106 and NSC-054 records. NSC-071 cannot be executed by a crew at all - one test path and zero implementation paths, refused at scope.py and again at run_crew.py:2116 - so it was authored directly, which is why the task had no pipeline history.
